trigger: cross-module contract (server field + client cache/key) and irreversible-ish write (dismiss)

doubts.claim_under_doubt: (a) the link keyed projectId:triageId cannot show the wrong task / loses nothing
doubts.finding: The key uses task.projectId, but the Fix-now modal lets the user change the project before saving. The task is then created under another project, so the link key no longer matches the item's project: the card silently stays at Fix now and a second task can be created. Nothing ties the link to the project the item came from.
doubts.disproof_attempt: Traced server create.ts: the id is stored (regex-checked) with no project check; buildTaskLinks pairs it with t.projectId. No test covers a modal project override.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: (d) per-card cache readers do not multiply requests
doubts.finding: Every card mounts a useQuery observer on the Board's polled all-projects key; default staleTime 0 makes each card mount refetch the full task list when the cache is not fresh, and each observer runs select over all tasks.
doubts.disproof_attempt: Read useExternalTasks.ts: same key, refetchInterval 2000 on the Board; no global staleTime override found.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: (c) the reason cannot be lost / Resolve acts on the intended state
doubts.finding: While the Resolve popup is open the 5s poll can flip the task to done; the card swaps to the non-task branch, the Resolve popover unmounts and the typed reason is discarded. No wrong item is dismissed (popup bound to item.id).
doubts.disproof_attempt: onConfirm is a.dismiss closed over item.id and only runs on explicit confirm; the card onClick ignores button/input targets; Enter guarded by pending. No wrong-item path found.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: (b) a done task releases the item and nothing else changes the card
doubts.finding: Release keyed only on done. launch_failed or jsonl_missing tasks keep showing In progress with Fix now hidden; the only exit is Resolve.
doubts.disproof_attempt: States are draft|awaiting_external_start|active|idle|jsonl_missing|launch_failed|done; done is the only terminal state.

doubts.finding: Object.assign after store.create then persist; the field is written only when present and the loader preserves it, so it is additive. sdk-sessions-store.ts is exactly 591 lines (baseline 591): zero headroom.

summary: No data-corrupting or wrong-item-dismiss path found. Two medium doubts (modal project selector breaks the link; per-card observers refetch on mount) must be fixed or rebutted.
